name: SUI
comment: A .sui holds units or bare attributes (a unit body pasted in by @include). The reader tells them apart by a '{' after the line, often on the next one, which a line-based grammar can't see. So a line is a unit header when a '{' follows on it, or when it is only `class : name` with a dotted name (a unit name: 19,181 such headers in ATS 1.61 .sui files, against 60 bare attributes that look like one). The rules come from sii.tmLanguage.json.
